metadata.NAME: Audio on 7.2.11: add the CS35L56 OT25 DAI the 7.2.11 machine driver waits for (backport of upstream 86c8360c97f6)
metadata.SUMMARY: Speakers/mic on 7.2.11 (sof_sdw: CODEC DAI cs35l56-ot25 not registered)
metadata.UPSTREAM: 7.2.11 took 4b7f393a01f8 ('ASoC: sdw_utils: Switch CS35L56/57/62/63 to use OT25 DAI') without 86c8360c97f6 ('ASoC: cs35l56: Add DAI for SDCA OT25 stream'); the latter was queued for 7.2.12 on 2026-10-17

modules.validation_note: Targets incomplete 7.2.11 backport; do not duplicate upstream fix.

metadata.NAME: Audio on 7.2.x: drop the ghost RT722 codec (backport of upstream ca02ffd4975c)
metadata.SUMMARY: Speakers/mic on 7.2.x kernels (sof_sdw probe -12 fix)
metadata.UPSTREAM: merged in 7.3 (ca02ffd4975c 'soundwire: dmi-quirks: Disable ghost Realtek on Asus Zenbook Duo'), not tagged for stable

modules.validation_note: Upstream 7.3 fix reported; test actual audio first.

metadata.NAME: KDE Plasma dual-screen support: rotation, hinge layout, touch mapping, keyboard dock, one brightness
metadata.SUMMARY: duo-rotate user service + both panels follow one brightness slider (KDE Plasma Wayland)
metadata.UPSTREAM: KWin rotates every output alike, resets touch orientation on rotation and binds the single backlight to eDP-1 only

modules.validation_note: Review dependencies, Qt build, actual display manager and lower-panel guard.

metadata.NAME: Panel widget: what the laptop draws (on battery and plugged in), charging rate, breakdown, temperatures, fans, power mode
metadata.SUMMARY: KDE panel widget showing how many watts the laptop draws, how fast the battery charges or drains, and where the power goes

modules.validation_note: Telemetry UI after core hardware is stable.

metadata.NAME: OLED brightness: use the eDP DPCD (AUX) backlight interface
metadata.SUMMARY: Screen brightness slider/keys actually change the OLED panels
metadata.UPSTREAM: VBT selects PWM; panels report BRIGHT_PWM_PIN=0, BRIGHT_AUX_SET=1 (DPCD 0x702=0x86); same fix used on other ASUS PTL OLEDs

modules.validation_note: Verify effective xe parameter and actual panel brightness response.

metadata.NAME: OLED panels: 10-bit through DSC instead of 6-bit + dithering
metadata.SUMMARY: Both panels at 30 bpp (DSC) instead of 18 bpp dithered; Panel Replay SU stays on
metadata.UPSTREAM: xe prefers lowering bpc over DSC on eDP (HBR2x4 cannot carry 2880x1800@144 at 8 bpc); 'prefer DSC' was rejected upstream, no module parameter. Needs display-psr-et-off (xe #8923: DSC + Early Transport corruption)

modules.validation_note: Colour-depth/DSC optimization; dependency and stability check required.

metadata.NAME: Bottom screen after a docked power-on: xe requests Type-C subsystem power for eDP-2
metadata.SUMMARY: Bottom screen works even when the laptop was powered on with the keyboard on it

modules.validation_note: Fixes startup-dependent lower-panel power; resolve rollback/hooks and validate DKMS/initramfs first.

metadata.NAME: Panel Replay: turn off Selective Update Early Transport (ghost cursors)
metadata.SUMMARY: No stale cursor copies on the top panel; Panel Replay SU stays on
metadata.UPSTREAM: unfixed: 7.3 adds no Early Transport change (ET alignment + SU area fixes already in 7.2.9); no module parameter, only the debugfs PSR debug bit

modules.validation_note: Targets Panel Replay Early Transport/cursor artifacts; not a proven DMC remedy.

metadata.NAME: Detachable keyboard: patched hid-asus (backlight, Fn hotkeys, USB 0x1cd7 + BT 0x1cd8)
metadata.SUMMARY: Keyboard backlight that actually changes + ASUS Fn keys (DKMS, 7.2.x/7.3.x)
metadata.UPSTREAM: no Duo IDs upstream; oversized (64 byte) SET_REPORT times out on this keyboard (-110)

modules.validation_note: Confirm IDs; use matching 7.3 source; validate docked/Bluetooth keys and LEDs.

metadata.NAME: Windows-equivalent power limits: thermald adaptive (Intel DTT tables from BIOS)
metadata.SUMMARY: PL1/PL2/TCC per profile like Windows (balanced: 20W -> 28-42W sustained)
metadata.UPSTREAM: userspace only (thermald --adaptive parses the BIOS GDDV/APAT/APCT tables)

modules.validation_note: Raises power limits via firmware tables; needs thermal and battery validation.

metadata.NAME: Lid closed over the docked keyboard: the keyboard no longer wakes the laptop
metadata.SUMMARY: No wake/suspend loop in the bag: the docked keyboard's USB wakeup is off while the lid is closed

modules.validation_note: Investigate docked keyboard remote-wakeup behavior before applying.

metadata.NAME: power-saver really saves power: asus-wmi quiet + SoC low-power + Xe power_saving
metadata.SUMMARY: PPD power-saver reaches Windows 'Whisper' (PL1 20-30W, quiet fans) and GPU power_saving
metadata.UPSTREAM: platform_profile aggregate = intersection of handlers: asus-wmi offers quiet, SoC slider offers low-power, so no low-power choice survives

modules.validation_note: Profile mapping changes require mode transition tests.

metadata.NAME: PCI runtime PM 'auto' for platform functions left at 'on'
metadata.SUMMARY: Bluetooth, CSME/HECI, DTT, telemetry, SRAM, eSPI, SPI, host bridge may runtime-suspend

modules.validation_note: Broad runtime-power policy; validate suspend and device behavior.

metadata.NAME: Stop the hwrng kthread polling the TPM (~20 wakeups/s)
metadata.SUMMARY: Kernel entropy keeps coming from RDRAND/RDSEED + jitter; fTPM/CSME stops being woken

modules.validation_note: Power/entropy policy, not a display repair.

metadata.NAME: Accelerometer mount matrix: panels are mounted upside down
metadata.SUMMARY: Sensor reports orientation relative to the (180 deg mounted) panels, auto-rotate is correct

modules.validation_note: Coordinate mount matrix with desktop rotation ownership.

metadata.NAME: Integrated Sensor Hub: ASUS-signed Panther Lake ISH firmware
metadata.SUMMARY: Accelerometer, ambient light and hinge sensors (rotation, auto brightness)
metadata.UPSTREAM: firmware not in linux-firmware (only Dell/HP/Lenovo PTL images); fetched from ASUS driver package

modules.validation_note: Verify ASUS package checksum/model and use firmware/updates path.

metadata.NAME: Health checks: warn after kernel updates and at login when a fix is not active
metadata.SUMMARY: pacman hook after kernel updates + one check per login; notifies only on problems

modules.validation_note: Useful ongoing checks/notifications; independently verify active drivers.

metadata.NAME: Keyboard touchpad: Apple's trackpad acceleration in KWin (until Plasma 6.9)
metadata.SUMMARY: Pixel-precise when moving slowly, crosses the screen with a short flick, docked and on Bluetooth
metadata.UPSTREAM: KWin custom acceleration (MR 6937, Plasma 6.9) could replace the library with kcminputrc settings

modules.validation_note: Preference/performance library, not required to make the machine boot.

metadata.NAME: Keyboard touchpad: no lost motion on Bluetooth, equal axes (USB 0x1cd7 + BT 0x1cd8)
metadata.SUMMARY: Cursor no longer drops motion on Bluetooth; up/down moves as fast as left/right
metadata.UPSTREAM: libinput: jump detection on MSC_TIMESTAMP; systemd hwdb/60-evdev.hwdb resolution entry

modules.validation_note: Bluetooth timing and axis normalization; validate versions and behavior.

metadata.NAME: Keyboard touchpad: palm rejection and disable-while-typing (USB 0x1cd7 + BT 0x1cd8)
metadata.SUMMARY: Touchpad ignores palms and pauses while you type, docked and on Bluetooth

modules.validation_note: Test disable-while-typing/palm rejection with actual keyboard.

metadata.NAME: Top touchscreen: HID-over-I2C instead of raydium_i2c_ts, touch aligned with the upside-down panel
metadata.SUMMARY: Top screen touch + pen work and land under the finger, fixes raydium_i2c_irq Oops
metadata.UPSTREAM: patch in kernel/patches (Input: raydium_i2c_ts: skip HID-over-I2C devices), not yet submitted

modules.validation_note: Inspect top touch binding; blacklist/calibrate only for matching hardware.

metadata.NAME: Wi-Fi power save only on battery (low latency on AC)
metadata.SUMMARY: On AC: Wi-Fi PS off (gateway RTT 16 ms avg / 158 ms spikes -> 7 ms); on battery: PS on

modules.validation_note: Installer mirror slowness does not establish a Wi-Fi power-save defect.

metadata.NAME: Wi-Fi roaming with WPA3/PMF: mac80211 deauthenticates from the AP it leaves
metadata.SUMMARY: Roams between the 5 and 6 GHz AP MLDs of one mesh unit (and reassociations) finish in ~70 ms instead of timing out

modules.validation_note: Additional mac80211 DKMS/hook compatibility; no local roaming failure recorded.
